svg.title: Large first prompts: where Guffin is slower
svg.desc: First-turn internal TTFT for the supplementary code-review and document-review cases, one observation per engine. Both panels have the same zero-based linear scale. Code review has 2054 tokens for Gemma 2 and 2060 for Gemma 3; document review has 4611. Counts match across engines within each pair. All six comparisons favor llama.cpp. Values in seconds: {"Code review": {"gemma2-release-v2": {"guffin": 13.682924, "llama": 13.29514}, "gemma3-normal-release-v2": {"guffin": 20.725807, "llama": 17.09178}, "gemma3-speculative-release": {"guffin": 20.665201, "llama": 17.80472}}, "Document review": {"gemma2-release-v2": {"guffin": 34.349855, "llama": 31.95299}, "gemma3-normal-release-v2": {"guffin": 47.687072, "llama": 38.60264}, "gemma3-speculative-release": {"guffin": 47.695511, "llama": 39.12419}}}
